newsitem.title: HONG KONG: S&P affirms Hutchison Whampoa ratings.
newsitem.headline: S&P affirms Hutchison Whampoa ratings.

text.p: Standard and Poor's Corp said its has affirmed the A-plus local currency rating and single-A foreign currency rating on Hutchison Whampoa Ltd.
S&P also affirmed the ratings on the company's guaranteed subsidiary Hutchison Delta Finance Ltd.
S&P said the outlook on Hutchison's foreign currency rating is positive, adding that the rating is constrained by Hong Kong's long-term sovereign rating outlook.
The outlook on the local currency rating is stable, S&P said.

The stable outlook on the local currency rating reflects the group's sound business portfolio, moderate leverage position and strong cash flow, offset by concentration risk and some exposure to the cyclical property market, S&P said.
S&P said that its affirmation of the company's ratings reflect Hutchsion Whampoa's diversified earnings from property, container terminals, retail, energy and telecommunications.

These service industries are basic to Hong Kong's long-term economic prosperity, generating reliable cash flows and consistent returns, offset somewhat by the concentration of some of its activities in Hong Kong.
